newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi says Italy interest rates "incredibly" high.
newsitem.headline: Prodi says Italy interest rates "incredibly" high.

text.p: Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Wednesday he thought Italian interest rates were very high given the recent sharp fall in inflation.
Preliminary data released earlier this week from 11 cities pointed to inflation dropping to 1.7 percent year-on-year this month from 2.2 percent in March.

"We have inflation under two percent and rates which are incredibly high," Prodi told a rally in this central Italian town. "When between 1964 and 1967 inflation was low, between two and three percent, the discount rate was 3.5 percent. In countries which have similar inflation to Italy, the discount rate is 3.5 percent. We have a rate of 6.75 percent. We have room for improvement."
